name: Footage cards multiply
what: One upright card with your video rises into view on a dark page, shrinks, and nine more cards fan out from under it into a grid of ten while the view count on every card steps up from 0 to millions.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f11-f60 one card rises from below the frame, overshoots by 30 px and settles; f60-f78 it shrinks to 70 %; f79-f101 nine more cards fan out from under it and all ten spread into a 5 x 2 grid (sharp S-curve, the first card on top); f110-f163 the view count on every card steps up about every 9 f (100, 1K, 100K, 500K, 900K, 1M, 2M)
